description: Analyze spin density of the clean rutile MnO2 (110) surface.
user_prompt: Perform spin density analysis on the clean MnO2 (110) surface (rutile structure, P4_2/mnm). Determine whether the system has unpaired electrons. If unpaired electrons are present, identify the element carrying the spin density and report the magnetic moment of the outermost (undercoordinated, five-fold) surface-layer metal atom; otherwise report that there is no spin-carrying element and report the maximum residual site magnetic moment.
